name_zh: 古斯塔夫/阿道夫/瑞典/三十年/狮子/军改/新教/狮子/古斯塔夫
description_zh: 古斯塔夫·阿道夫（1594-1632），瑞典国王，狮子王，军事改革家，新教徒，三十年战争领导者，军事天才，改革瑞典军队，建立现代兵制，领导瑞典参与三十年战争，对欧洲军事和宗教改革产生深远影响。
description_en: Gustavus Adolphus (1594-1632), Swedish King, Lion King, military reformer, Protestant, Thirty Years' War leader, military genius, reformed Swedish army, established modern military system, led Swedish participation in Thirty Years' War, profoundly influenced European military and religious reform.

reason_en: Gustavus Adolphus was military reformer and Thirty Years' War leader, his military reforms and military genius profoundly influenced European military and religious reform.
